text: In 2016 the 2014-2018 Congestion Management Plan was extended to 2020. A Note provided to City Council on key city issues for the 2018-2022 term stated that a congestion management status report would be provided in early 2019, and an updated Congestion Management Plan for the 2021-2025 period by the end of 2019. I have consulted with the Clerk's office and no update has been received this year.

The Infrastructure and Environment Committee: 1. Requested the General Manager, Transportation Services to provide an update on the Congestion Management Plan to the Infrastructure and Environment Committee at its November 7, 2019 meeting.
